name: Decypharr VOD
description: v1.0.5: Imports Decypharr media as native Dispatcharr VOD with one canonical relation per movie, series, and episode; preserves source identity across title/path renames; TMDB genres remain categories/metadata rather than additional streams; includes reliable background scanning, refresh protection, FFprobe metadata, artwork, and optional hardware-accelerated browser transcoding.
author: Tw1zT3d2four7

fields.label: Preferred Audio Language

fields.label: About Browser Transcoding
fields.help_text: When enabled, only Dispatcharr web-player-incompatible media is converted to H.264/AAC. Other clients are not transcoded.
